newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU seeks comments on Boeing /McDonnell merger.
newsitem.headline: EU seeks comments on Boeing /McDonnell merger.

text.p: The European Commission is seeking comments on the proposed merger between Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp which is currently being investigated under EU rules banning creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
In a notice published in the European Union's Official Journal dated May 1, the Commission gave interested third parties 15 days to file their comments.

The Commission started a full probe into the deal between the two U.S. aircraft makers on March 19. European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert has also expressed strong concerns about the impact on fair competition due, in particular, to Boeing's exclusive long-term supply deals with Delta Air Lines Inc and AMR Corp's American Airlines.

European aerospace consortium Airbus Industrie, Boeing's only serious competitor, has already made its views known to the Commission during the early phase of the merger review. Its individual partners, British Aerospace, Aerospatiale of France, Daimler-Benz Aerospace and Spain's CASA , are also believed to have made separate comments.

The Commission is expected to communicate its objections on the merger to Boeing later this month and then to organise a private hearing with the two partners and other interested parties. A final decision must be reached before the end of July.
